cohort: Ventilated neonates with gestational age > 28 weeks and birth weight >1000 grams admitted to the NICU, excluding those with gestational age < 28 weeks, birth weight < 1000 grams, multiple congenital anomalies, and those who died within 6 hours of admission.
finding: The survival rate of ventilated neonates was 57.34%, with respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) being the most common indication for ventilation and ventilator-associated pneumonia being the most common complication.
followup_time: Length of stay in NICU (variable, up to August 2020 from admission between July 2018-August 2020)
